idea-plugin.name: Code2Request
idea-plugin.description:
From Spring Controller to a runnable HTTP request, in one click.

Click the icon next to any controller method. Code2Request reads your mappings and parameters and fills in a ready-to-send request with realistic sample values. Edit what you need, hit Run, and see the response without leaving the IDE.

  • Gutter icon and right-click action on Spring MVC / Spring Boot controller methods (Java and Kotlin)
  • Path variables, query params, headers, JSON bodies and file uploads
  • Smart sample values: email, phone, pageSize… get realistic data, not just "test"
  • Nested DTOs, lists and enums expanded into JSON; respects @JsonProperty and fastjson @JSONField
  • Environments (local / dev / test) with common headers such as Authorization
  • Drafts saved per endpoint, so your last request is always there

Lightweight by design: no account, no cloud, no cluttered toolbar.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.3.0

  • Kotlin controller support
  • Common headers per environment (e.g. Authorization token)
  • Switching environment now updates the request URL
  • Requests open in the environment you used last instead of always "local"
  • List / array / Map fields generate a sample element instead of an empty value
  • JSON field names follow @JsonProperty, @JSONField and @SerializedName (on fields, getters, or Kotlin constructor parameters); @JsonIgnore fields are skipped
  • Fixed: DTOs whose names start with "Set" or "Map" were treated as collections
  • Fixed: two fields of the same DTO type now both get a sample
  • Removed debug notifications

action.description: Generate and run HTTP request from Spring Controller method
